# permission API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Local checks against supplied SharePoint permission snapshots.

## hasSPFxPermission

Tests a SharePoint permission set using its hasPermission method. Undefined sets return false. This is a local capability check; it does not authorize a server operation or acquire Graph scopes. Failures from the supplied hasPermission method are not caught.

### Imports

```ts
import { hasSPFxPermission } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { hasSPFxPermission } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/helpers';
```

### Use when

- You have a SharePoint permission snapshot and need to decide whether to present a capability.

### Examples

```ts
import type { PageContext } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
import { hasSPFxPermission } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function exampleUsage(pageContext: PageContext) {
  const canEdit = hasSPFxPermission(pageContext.web.permissions, SPPermission.editListItems);
}
```

### Signatures

```ts
(permissionSet: SPPermission | undefined, permission: SPPermission): boolean
```

#### Parameters

- `permissionSet`: Host permission set, or undefined when unavailable.
- `permission`: SharePoint permission bit to inspect.

#### Returns

True when the supplied set contains the requested permission.

#### Return shape

#### hasSPFxPermission return branch 1

```ts
false
```

#### hasSPFxPermission return branch 2

```ts
true
```

### Related types

- SPPermission — external dependency (`node_modules/@microsoft/sp-page-context/dist/index-internal.d.ts`); its upstream contract applies.
